name: Linear
description: Three chapters progress in sequence, consistently following Theme A.
instructions: Contains ONLY 3 nodes and 2 edges in total.

name: Arch
description: The narrative begins with Theme A, then shifts to Theme B, and finally returns to Theme A.
instructions: Contains ONLY 3 nodes and 2 edges in total.

name: Ladder
description: The narrative begins with Theme A, then shifts to Theme B, and finally shifts to Theme C.
instructions: Contains ONLY 3 nodes and 2 edges in total.

name: LongFork
description: The narrative follows Theme A for two chapters, then diverges to Theme B in the third chapter.
instructions: Contains 3 nodes and 2 edges in total.

name: ShortFork
description: The narrative follows Theme A for one chapter, then diverges to Theme B in the second chapter.
instructions: Contains 3 nodes and 2 edges in total.

name: WideMerge
description: Two initial chapters, each from Themes A and C, converge into a shared Theme B in the subsequent chapter.
instructions: Contains 3 nodes and 2 edges in total.

name: WideBranch
description: From Theme B, the narrative branches out to both Themes A and C in the following chapters.
instructions: Contains 3 nodes and 2 edges in total.

name: SharpMerge
description: A chapter from Theme A and another from Theme B converge into a single chapter under Theme B.
instructions: Contains 3 nodes and 2 edges in total.

name: SharpBranch
description: A chapter under Theme A diverges into two chapters, one continuing Theme A and another shifting to Theme B.
instructions: Contains 3 nodes and 2 edges in total.
